description_sq:
Ne zonen e Kinostudios ofrojme apartament per shitje te tipologjise 1+1.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe prej 81.4m2 bruto dhe 74m2 neto.
Eshte i organizuar ne nje korridor i cili bene shperndarjen ne nje sallon te bollshem se bashku me ambjentin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi , nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.
Bashke me apartamentin disponojme edhe garazh me cmim ekstra.
Per me shume detaje apo nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni.
description_en: In the area of ​​Kinostudios, we offer an apartment for sale of the typology 1+1. The apartment has a surface area of ​​81.4m2 gross and 74m2 net. It is organized in a corridor which divides into a spacious living room together with a kitchen area, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. Along with the apartment, we also have a garage at an extra cost. For more details or a visit to the property, contact me.
